attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his signed Substack retrospective of 2025. He states this in his own voice and is not quoting anyone.

semantics.note: A present-tense description of 2025 with no hedge. Treating it as an observation that neurosymbolic AI is starting to rise in prominence is faithful. The draft drops the parenthetical definition, but that changes nothing.

contract.note: Marcus named no measure. Reading the claim as growing research attention and visible development during 2025 is fair and ordinary. It does not require dominance or commercial uptake, and 'starting' is correctly read as emerging momentum rather than the field's origin. The result depends on this reading.

evidence.note: An arXiv survey from August 2025 calls the neuro-symbolic LLM-reasoning field rapidly developing, with a vast number of publications. This is contemporaneous qualitative support for growing research activity, though it gives no annual counts.

Proceedings of the 1st neuro-symbolic applications workshop at ECAI 2025 (October 2025): 29 submissions, 25 accepted. A new dedicated venue inside the target period corroborates expanding attention. It was published before the evaluation date.
A systematic review of 2020–2024 reports rapid growth since 2020. This is the baseline period, not the target period, so it is context only. It also shows the momentum began before 2025.

reviews.rationale: Under the fair plain reading, two independent 2025 records point the same way: a survey describing rapid development and many publications, and a new dedicated workshop with substantial submissions. That meets the contract's support condition. The packet contains no evidence of flat or declining activity. There is no comparable 2024-to-2025 publication count, so the support is qualitative but adequate under the contract.
